corpus: mixed human/model final text from earlier sessions
finding: No useful primary personal advantage is established. Useful base and pooled advantage remains unresolved under both interval methods; useful donor and uniform advantage is excluded under both. All primary intervals include zero. Adapted-minus-base donor and pooled useful advantage remains unresolved under both methods, with both model-rival intervals including zero. Residual uniform useful advantage is excluded under both methods; performance is worse only under writer resampling. Raw base, pooled and donor useful advantage remains unresolved under both methods, with all model-rival intervals including zero. Raw sums are worse than uniform under both methods. No parity follows.
limits: Mixed human/model provenance, sparse histories, overlapping human units, fixed donor/global training and exposed prompts bound the tested recipe. No independent human confirmation, seed ranking, population limit, private-goal inference or whole-matrix verdict. Earlier failed/unknown attempts remain separate; no new retry.
